flow_mapping.source: census/round-7/quarantine-plan.json execution_plan_template + SKILL.md removal flow + AGENTS.md receipt/hold/signoff rules
flow_mapping.step_0_recheck: --check: gate1 unpushed-touching (explicit --branches --not --remotes form; r6 pitfall respected), gate2 dirty-touching (--untracked-files=all), gate3 dual-engine receipt (souji-verify AND souji-vault-verify both SAFE, same class in {pushed, moved-to-obsidian, stale, metadata-prune}, --expect-receipt pin)
flow_mapping.step_1_stage: --stage: AUTHORIZED required, then plain mv (never git mv) to <repo>/.ufo-quarantine/<UTC-date>/<rel with / -> __> + sidecar <dest>.souji-qrecord.json (original, repo, receipt, both engine receipts, intro commit, vault path/sha for obsidian rows, content digest, staged epoch, hold floor). The owning repo's quarantine commit is left to parent/operator by design (AGENTS.md; this tool never commits)
flow_mapping.step_2_hold: hold floor default 450s (one driver tick) from the record's staged_at_epoch; SKILL.md's 24h preference for non-pushed is surfaced in --plan, enforcement floor is 450s, waived only for receipt pushed
flow_mapping.step_3_second_check: --verify-staged: record integrity + staged-copy digest re-hash + gate1 re-run on the original (history-based, mv-proof) + gate2 re-run tolerating ONLY the quarantine's own ` D <orig>` deletion lines + class-appropriate receipt re-verification (stale -> both engines on the copy; pushed -> recorded intro still ancestor of resolved default ref; moved-to-obsidian -> recorded vault side re-hashed read-only)
flow_mapping.step_4_retire: --retire: second check must pass NOW + nonempty --operator-signoff + hold elapsed (unless pushed) -> rm ONLY the staged copy and its record; every refusal names its reason and exits 1 leaving everything in place

deliberate_restrictions: metadata-prune classifies via --check but --stage REFUSES stage-unsupported-receipt: worktree registrations retire via worktree tooling, not file mv (T15)
nested stale targets refuse to stage: flattening dir/name -> dir__name breaks the engines' anchored scratch patterns, so the mandatory copy-side re-check could never pass (T18)
moved-to-obsidian staging requires regular-file source AND vault (dir rows need dir-digest machinery this tool does not duplicate)
gate2 second-check waiver tolerates exactly the quarantine's own deletions; anything else regresses the check

known limitation (carried from r7, documented in the tool header): ignored paths are gate2-invisible, so an ignored target's cleanliness is only as durable as its .gitignore rule; record + second check + operator signoff bound the exposure and the operator should confirm the ignore rule is itself pushed
